job.question: In the Shrewsbury Contributory Retirement System RFP for investment consultant services, how long is the chosen consultant expected to be retained?
job.expected_facts: For five (5) years, not to exceed seven (7) years including any renewal, extension or option. The Board can terminate on thirty (30) days written notice.
job.acceptance: Five years and seven-year total ceiling including renewals/extensions/options. Thirty-day termination is optional.

reviews.reason: This is an Arizona Public Safety Personnel Retirement System RFP, not the Shrewsbury Contributory Retirement System RFP. Its proposed contract term is three years with two possible one-year extensions; it does not support the required five-year term or seven-year total ceiling.
quotes: This Request for Proposal (“RFP”) is issued by the Board of Trustees (“Board”) of the Public Safety Personnel Retirement System (“System”)
It is anticipated that the contract will be offered for an initial term of three years, with two possible one- year extensions before it will be bid again.
